story: After several attacks, a group of eight riders formed the breakaway. With about 26 kilometers to go, Michael Valgren and Julian Alaphilippe broke away from the other escapees. On the final climb, Valgren dropped Alaphilippe and managed to stay just ahead of the general classification favorites to take the stage victory.
